philosophy: Performance golf, TrackMan truth, coaching and fitting seriousness — where good golfers get better. Restraint over entertainment-bar golf cliches.
visual_philosophy: Moody indoor studio over flat studio white. In-the-moment swing and launch-monitor truth over posed stock golf. Premium sports-apparel campaign feel; photo-real people and simulators.
composition_rules: Restraint over decoration; generous negative space
One clear focal subject per frame
Photo-real or near photo-real for people and TrackMan bays
anti_patterns: Entertainment-bar golf cliches and neon cyber-golf
Stock golfer-grin energy and Canva-style template slideshows
Six fonts or busy type stacks in the image
Obviously AI-rendered faces or plastic skin
Invented prices, yards instead of metres, or fake offers
people_policy: Photo-real golfers and coaches in sim bays; candid mid-action preferred over posed grins; no caricature or uncanny AI faces.

copy_split.on_image: hook, stat, or proof — numbers-led only
copy_split.caption: written separately; must not duplicate overlay copy

market.pricing: never invent prices or offers in generated imagery
